img.caption: Fig 2: Main results across CLINC150 / MixATIS / MixSNIPS. Ours (red) achieves the best Set IoU on multi-intent datasets and best Macro-F1 on CLINC150, while being the only method with 100% OOS refusal.
Fig 3: Calibration quality (ECE, lower is better) and false-reject rate. Ours attains the lowest ECE on CLINC150 (0.005) and MixSNIPS (0.045), while QP-OneModel over-refuses on CLINC150 (86%).

Fig 4: Three-state decision distribution (release / clarify / reject) under FPR95 calibration. CLINC150 releases almost all in-domain queries; multi-intent datasets route the majority to interactive clarification rather than forced single-label output.
